scope: Opt-in native-BF16 Triton fusion of token shift and six mix6 projections, restricted to RWKV7 single-sequence cache-all prefill to avoid the rejected decode use case.

accuracy.operator: Exact BF16 parity for T=1/13/257 with and without [hidden] cached state; test_rwkv7_prefill_shift_mix6_matches_reference
accuracy.service: Fixed 4096 raw-token prompt generated 16/16 identical output token IDs against the retained path

workload: cold unique raw-token prompt, B=1, 16 output tokens, two measured rounds after warmup; --enforce-eager --enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align
conclusion: Rejected and reverted: the isolated fused operator was faster, but end-to-end cold prefill showed no stable benefit: +0.45% at 4K and regressions at 16K (-0.26%) and 64K (-0.20%). These deltas are within noise and do not meet the stable positive service-performance gate.
